Eraka
a teacher of Abhinavagupta on the esoteric side.
See Tantrālokavyākhyā, Vol. III. Kas. Texts 30. p. 192.
A Stotra of his is mentioned, ibid. p. 193.

Eraṇḍakalpa
Q. in Yogaratnasamuccaya of Anantakumāra, TSS. 152. II. 441.

Erra_Mādhava
or arra mAdhava of Śrīvatsagotra.
--Tripadadyotinī. gr. Hz. 313. MT. 4290.
See under Mādhava Bhaṭṭa.
